fixture_ownership.requirement: live runs must verify fresh exact fixture ownership (owned accounts, no human sessions) through the reviewed preflight operator

sql_readback.requirement: a fresh all-offline SQL readback of the exact owned fixtures must run before and after the live window

walk_audit.arrival_semantics: native_gameplay.py:378-398: a 0x0087 walkok sets arrival only when its start position equals its destination (zero-cell walk), so a 1-cell walk confirms only via the NEXT walkok starting at the pending cell; if no rx frames flow at all the pending gate never opens.
walk_audit.release_predicate: playing_runtime.py:1219-1237 clears _pending only on `view.arrival_confirmed and pos.seq > seq and (pos.x, pos.y) == point`; otherwise it re-sends the SAME point after >=1.0s up to 3 retries, then raises NativeTelemetryUnavailable. A missing ack therefore holds wire sends silently instead of failing the dispatch.
walk_audit.window2_attribution: wire-send side: window 2's 16 dispatched MoveTo actions reached perform_native honestly (the dispatch counters sit upstream of every gate), but the pending-walk gate holds each dispatch while a walk is unacknowledged - playing_runtime.py:1061-1062 (`if self._await_pending(view, pos): return`) - so the only wire send was the first dispatch's single next-path-step at playing_runtime.py:1070-1073 (`point = path[1]; self.wire.move(*point)`), matching the observed 1-tile displacement.
walk_audit.window3_discriminator: frame_timeline rows pair dispatched_actions.moveTo with walk_sends (0x035F at the wrapped _send seam) and walk_acks (0x0087): sends present with zero acks = ack path blocker; zero actor frames = map-session ingestion blocker; attackable actors observed with acks flowing = travel/targeting blocker.
